fields.name: tailSize
fields.comment: high: Create computes the trailing-array size n and calls FastAlloc(n+0x40); ctor (unnamed FUN_00076fe0) stores n at +0; operator_delete(p,sz) does FastFree(p, *p + sz) and callers pass sz=0x40. PS2 identical (sw a3,0(s1); operator delete lw v0,0(a0)

fields.name: owner

fields.name: procAnims

fields.name: systems

fields.name: systemIds
fields.comment: high: sorted byte array (lower_bound<unsigned char>) of numSystems system IDs, the last trailing array; ctor fills it from sys+0x15. Existing Ghidra name pSystemIds

fields.name: effects
fields.comment: high: first trailing array after the instances (this+(numInstances+1)*0x40), numEffects 0x40-byte effect records copied from the anim descriptor; FindEffectByID returns effects+i*0x40; RSceneObj Toggle/Trigger/Damage/Decay/SuppressEffects walk it (+0

fields.name: effectBits
fields.comment: high: PS2/Xbox SetEffectBits(i,v) stores a ushort at +0x18[i]; DamageEffects/TriggerEffects mask against it. The byte array of effect IDs follows it in the same block: FindEffectByID reads byte effectBits+2*numEffects+i

fields.name: numInstances
fields.comment: high: ctor stores Create's instance count; tail starts at this+(n+1)*0x40; UseInstanceList loops instances [0,n) at this+0x40 stride 0x40. PS2 sb t0,0x1c

fields.name: numProcAnims
fields.comment: high: ctor: count of 0x20-byte procAnims records (Create counts instances with flag 0x10 when a ProcAnimState table is given)

fields.name: numSystems
fields.comment: high: loop bound in InitAllSystemStates/AnySystemPlaying/ProcessStimuli*; length for lower_bound on systemIds. Existing Ghidra name bSystemCount

fields.name: numEffects
fields.comment: high: FindEffectByID and all RSceneObj effect loops are bounded by it

fields.name: activeEffectMask
fields.comment: high: ToggleEffect sets/clears bit i; Trigger/Damage/Decay/RenderEffects test it !=0 to arm/clear RSceneObj.effectDecayTime; ctor zeroes it (PS2 sd zero,0x20)

fields.name: damageEffectMask
fields.comment: high: ctor ORs bit i when effect flags &8; DamageEffects early-outs unless nonzero and toggles only those effects

fields.name: gfxEffectMask
fields.comment: medium: ctor ORs bit i when effect type byte (+0x14) == 6; ToggleEffect calls GFX::Trigger/Purge only for effects in this mask (otherwise it only flips activeEffectMask); SuppressEffects/DecayEffects filter on it. Name invented

fields.name: triggerEffectMask
fields.comment: medium: ctor ORs bit i when effect flags &0x96; TriggerEffects/SuppressEffects early-out unless nonzero and act only on its bits that are not damage bits. Name invented

fields.name: instance
fields.comment: high: (Instance&,ProcAnimState&) ctor stores arg1; GetPosition returns instance+0x30, GetOrientMat copies *instance; Update reads instance+0x30..0x38 for velocity; RPathEngine::GetPathHandle(instance) matches on it. Same on PS2

fields.name: procAnim
fields.comment: high: ctor arg2 (0x20-byte record, type byte 2): Init reads +0xc path, +0x10 master id, +0x14 start time, +0x18 speed, +0x1c flag, +4 bit15 running; Update/Init call the vtable[0x38] of the object at procAnim+8

fields.name: baseMatrix
fields.comment: high: ctor copies the 16 instance words, then zeroes words 3/7/11 and sets [15]=1.0 (instance w-lanes carry packed data); Init/Update MatrixCopy(this+8) before EvaluateMatrix. Same offset on PS2 (unaligned ldl/ldr copy, no padding)

fields.name: applyMatrix
fields.comment: medium: Init sets it to identity (DAT_001917b0) or through VU0_MATRIX4Init when procAnim+0x1c is set; Update/Init post-multiply the evaluated path matrix by it. Name invented

fields.name: velocity
fields.comment: high: Update: (newPos - instance+0x30)*k; ctor/Init set it from zero vector DAT_00243030; RSceneObj::GetVelocity and EPathSFXUpdate (sound velocity +0x20) read it. 12 bytes on PS2 too (+0x94 is the next field)

fields.name: lastUpdateTime
fields.comment: high: Init/Update store scale*t*60; Update returns early when now - this <= 0. PS2 lwc1/swc1 0x94

fields.name: currentPath
fields.comment: high: PS2 SetCurrentPath = sw 0x98; GetParametricDuration returns *(float*)currentPath (duration at PathInfo+0); Update wraps time against it; Init sets it from procAnim+0xc

fields.name: nextPath
fields.comment: high: SetNextPath = store 0x9c (both builds); Update switches currentPath to it when time passes the end

fields.name: masterHandle
fields.comment: high: Init looks up the handle whose instance == procAnim+0x10 in the global list (node+8); Update then derives time from master->parametricTime; SetParametricTime is ignored while set; WTriggerManager::Update only processes handles with 0 here

fields.name: speed
fields.comment: high: PS2 SetSpeed = swc1 0xa4 (no Xbox SetSpeed); Init from procAnim+0x18; Update multiplies throttle*speed*dt

fields.name: timeDelta
fields.comment: medium: Update stores throttle*speed*dt here when free-running, and uses time = master->parametricTime - this when slaved; Init sets master time - own time. Dual use, name invented

fields.name: parametricTime
fields.comment: high: SetParametricTime stores 0xac (both builds); passed to EvaluateMatrix/ComputeChannel; Init from procAnim+0x14

fields.name: posKnot
fields.comment: medium: EvaluateMatrix in/out knot hint for the position channel (EvaluateLinear/Spline return the knot index); copy ctor zeroes it (both builds)

fields.name: rotKnot
fields.comment: medium: EvaluateMatrix in/out knot hint for the rotation channel; copy ctor zeroes it

fields.name: pathW
fields.comment: low: EvaluateMatrix out: 4th lane of the evaluated position channel (0 when there is no channel). Meaning unknown, name invented

fields.name: throttle
fields.comment: high: SetThrottle stores 0xbc (both builds); Init 1.0; Update ramps it toward desiredThrottle by acceleration

fields.name: acceleration
fields.comment: high: SetAcceleration stores 0xc0; Init 1.0; Update step size

fields.name: desiredThrottle
fields.comment: high: SetDesiredThrottle stores 0xc4; Init 1.0; Update target

fields.name: accelDelay
fields.comment: high: SetAccelDelay stores 0xc8 (decompiler prints it as decimal 200; PS2 integer sw); Update decrements it and ramps only once it is 0

fields.name: running
fields.comment: high: SetRunning byte store on Xbox; Init = procAnim flags bit15; Update skips when 0 and clears it at path end. PS2 stores a WORD here (sw a1,0xcc; ctor and copy ctor move a word): Xbox is 1 byte + 3 padding

fields.name: userData

fields.name: vtable

fields.name: rigidBodySlot

fields.name: feedbackObject
fields.comment: high: SetFeedbackObject store; dtor ~IFeedback + FastFree(p,4). PS2 +0x50 feedback

fields.comment: high: SetHitPointLoc stores a POINTER owned by the subclass; GetHitPoints returns *p or 1.0, LoseHitPoints/ApplyDamage decrement *p clamped at 0. PS2 +0x54 ptrHealth
